state.paragraph: In mid-June 2016, at the direction of the Transaction Committee, representatives of GHF instructed all potential buyers to submit non-binding letters of intent ("LOIs") by July 20, 2016, together with mark-ups of the forms of merger agreement, disclosure letter and voting agreement, which GHF indicated would be posted to the internet data site. Potential buyers were instructed to provide a valuation for the Company based on the purchase of 100% of the outstanding common stock on a dollar per share basis (assuming conversion of the preferred stock into common stock) or the financial terms of any non-cash proposal.

ledger_rows.Note: Every potential buyer told to submit a non-binding IOI by 05/10/2016; memorandum already sent to NDA signers.
IOI due date moved from 05/10 to 05/19/2016. Day not given; Date from assumes 05/10 was still operative at the 04/27 Board discussion.
IOI due date reached. IOIs arrived 05/19 to 06/01.

Range for the group; $/share assumes preferred converts; equity $90M-$134M. Made before data-site access. By later events includes B, G&W, D, E, F and the two LOI non-submitters (#29-30): 5 strategic, 2 financial, 2 unknown.
25 NDA signers (#8-9) − 9 IOI bidders (#14) = 16. None reappears. May include Party A, which the filing never mentions after March.
Transaction Committee excluded the two lowest IOIs from management presentations to save management time. Identities and types not disclosed; may include Party A.
Committee advanced the other seven IOI bidders to in-person management presentations and further diligence; all seven got internet data-site access.
Non-binding LOIs due 07/20/2016 with mark-ups of the merger agreement, disclosure letter and voting agreement; price per share for 100% of common. Drafts posted 06/29, 06/30, 07/11.
New strategic buyer approached management unsolicited, expressing interest in acquiring the Company; late entrant during the LOI stage.
Signed after its approach and before its 07/12 IOI; then received the memorandum. It may not be counted in the filing's 25-NDA total.
IOI; equity value $108M. Made before data-site access (Heavy by context).
Catch-up access for late entrant: Party C got data-site access and a telephone management presentation (07/14); the seven others had in-person presentations.
LOI due date reached; six LOIs arrived in late July, G&W's on 07/21.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

deadline.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker sets, changes or communicates a bid deadline, process letter or request for final offers. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
